profile.headline: Software Engineer at Boeing, Graduate student at Johns Hopkins University, Whiting School of Engineering
profile.summary: Software Engineer based in Germantown, MD specializing in C++ and Python development for avionics systems, Hardware in the Loop integration, and deployment strategies for large scale software projects. I have a BS in Computer Science from Virginia Tech and currently pursuing a MS in Information Systems Engineering through Johns Hopkins’ Engineering for Professionals program. My primary academic interests are in the fields of Human Factors Engineering and Human Computer Interaction.

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description: Software engineer working primarily with C++ and Python to develop, test, and integrate flight software.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Developed a scalable self service business process building application and deployed within a self-managed cloud.

Gained experience with Ansible, Terraform, AWS technologies, such as EKS, ECR, EC2, S3 etc.

Worked to make a Kogito based app built on Quarkus.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Developed and integrated client tailored components to existing large scale code base, primarily focusing on front end.

positions.title: IT Strategic Support Intern- The Goodyear Tire & Rubber Company
positions.description: IT Strategic Support Intern - Dealt with Goodyear International IT resolutions by developing a new timesheet automation program for use with Goodyear’s international dev teams.
